name: CONV-D
save: Chrome downloads saveAs dialog; user chooses the local destination
activation: Dashboard button Ativar CONV toggles convDEnabled in chrome.storage.local
behavior: button injected into supported conversation pages and remounted after SPA/DOM navigation
identity: exports preserve detected user/assistant roles and platform message IDs when the platform exposes them; no private account ID is fabricated
format_note: DOC uses Word-compatible HTML and XLS uses Excel SpreadsheetML; the user explicitly selects the format before saving
conversation_url_module: Central de Ferramentas > CONVERSAS POR URL validates an authenticated AI conversation URL and opens the exact conversation so CONV-D can operate there
repository_field: A GitHub repository URL may be recorded as the intended destination, but this extension module does not perform force-push, embed credentials, or publish private conversation data automatically
download_link: Central de Ferramentas > Download por Link supports HTTP/HTTPS file URLs with the browser save dialog and supported AI conversation URLs
quick_queue: Central de Ferramentas > Fila Rápida stores local file metadata in chrome.storage.local for later processing
zip_crx: Central de Ferramentas > Selecionar .ZIP/.CRX adds local packages to the queue for later audit/extraction
